name: sg-semicon-expansion-plugin
description: Step-by-step US prospecting for Singapore semiconductor SMEs using three review-gated skills.

interface.shortDescription: Start here for step-by-step US prospecting.
interface.longDescription: Start with $map-sme-capability. It explains the three-step workflow, creates the first capability profile, and tells you what to review before moving on. After each step, the skill prints the exact next command to type. In Codex, users can also press $ in the thread and select the next skill. Later steps auto-detect the latest matching files in data/.
defaultPrompt: Use $map-sme-capability for [SME website or company profile].
